question: Which of the following helps the coffee flowers to blossom in Karnataka?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Blossom shower.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Blossom shower** is a weather phenomenon that occurs in** Karnataka **during the months of **February and March**, which helps the coffee flowers to blossom.
 
• This shower is a combination of **light rain and sunshine**, which is essential for the growth of** coffee flowers.**
 
• These pre-monsoon showers are **critical for the timely blossoming of coffee flowers** and the subsequent development of the beans.
 
• A good Blossom shower is integral to the** yield and quality** of the coffee crop for the season.
 
• Absence or inadequate Blossom showers can negatively impact the coffee yield.
 
• It is a localized weather occurrence prevalent in the** Western Ghats region of India.**​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nor'westers **are thunderstorms that occur in the **northern and eastern parts** of India during the summer months, and they do not have any impact on the coffee flowers in Karnataka.
 
• **Loo** is a **hot and dry wind **that blows across the **northern and central parts** of India during the summer months, and it is not related to the growth of coffee flowers.
 
• **Mango shower **is a **pre-monsoon rain** that occurs in the **southern parts **of India during the months of April and May, and it is not related to the growth of coffee flowers.
